nodes.label: Training Data
nodes.detail: Curated image-caption, visual knowledge, and OCR data used for alignment.

evidence.quote: We utilize a curated dataset of approximately 67B tokens, consisting of high-quality image-caption pairs, visual knowledge collections, and optical character recognition (OCR) data.

nodes.label: Vision Encoder
nodes.detail: SigLIP-2 vision encoder trained with dynamic input resolutions.

evidence.quote: We utilize the SigLIP-2 architecture as our vision encoder and continue training it with dynamic input resolutions

nodes.label: VL Merger
nodes.detail: Two-layer MLP compresses visual features into visual tokens aligned with the LLM.

evidence.quote: we use a two-layer MLP to compress visual features from the vision encoder into a single visual token, aligned with the LLM’s hidden dimension.

nodes.label: LLM Backbone
nodes.detail: Qwen3 large language model backbone in the three-module architecture.

evidence.quote: Qwen3-VL adopts a three-module architecture comprising a vision encoder, an MLP-based vision–language merger, and a large language model (LLM).

nodes.label: Interleaved MRoPE
nodes.detail: Positional encoding that interleaves temporal, horizontal, and vertical components.

evidence.quote: We therefore adopt an interleaved MRoPE that distributes t, h, and w uniformly across low- and high-frequency bands

nodes.label: DeepStack
nodes.detail: Cross-layer fusion routing visual tokens to corresponding LLM layers.

evidence.quote: we incorporate the pioneering DeepStack mechanism. Visual tokens from different layers of the vision encoder are routed to corresponding LLM layers via lightweight residual connections

nodes.label: Pretraining
nodes.detail: Four-phase pretraining pipeline from alignment to long-context adaptation.

evidence.quote: Our training pipeline consists of two stages: pretraining and post-training. Pretraining proceeds in four phases:

nodes.label: Post-Training
nodes.detail: Three-phase post-training with SFT, distillation, and reinforcement learning.

evidence.quote: Post-training comprises three phases: (i) supervised fine-tuning on long chain-of-thought data, (ii) knowledge distillation from stronger teacher models, and (iii) reinforcement learning.

nodes.label: Qwen3-VL
nodes.detail: Dense and MoE vision-language model family built on Qwen3 backbones.

evidence.quote: Qwen3-VL is instantiated in three dense variants (Qwen3-VL-2B/4B/8B/32B) and two MoE variants (Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B), all built upon Qwen3 backbones.

nodes.detail: Multimodal reasoning benchmark evaluation of the Qwen3-VL series.
